title: Minestrone with white beans and Parmesan
steps: Finely dice the onion, garlic, carrots, celery and courgette.
Sweat in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and rinsed beans and cook for 10 more minutes until the pasta is done.
Season with salt and serve with Parmesan and basil.
